title: Patk's Shields
description: Inspired by the Buff Banner from Team Fortress 2. I made 9 shields with custom models that have a team wide active ability.
body:
There are 9 banners all with unique effects that affect all selected players in a certain radius while active.
They have 4 modes that are cycled by shift-use while in offhand
1. Blocking: functioning as a normal shield to make sure there is no acidental activation
2. Activating: while using while uncrouched activates the banner for its full duration. The effects are only active while in offhand but it can be enabled in mainhand.
3. Recruiting: punching someone with the shield in your hand marks them as someone affected by your banner
4. Revoking: opposite of revoking

Summaries of each banner will be added soon.
